scope: Local uncommitted audit implementations; isolated actual retained catalogue and real media; no deployment or live database changes. Authored CI/process/DOM fixtures are supplementary, not real-data benchmarks.

source.fingerprintAlgorithm: Native acceptance owner fingerprint is SHA256 of sorted compact JSON for the 18 files in nativeAcceptanceFiles. Final files additionally include unchanged/rejected owners, dependency lock, browser driver and audit documentation.

provenance.browser: Chromium headless shell cache build 1243 on macOS arm64
provenance.privateRetention: Never commit raw SQL plans/parameters, DOM/heap snapshots, credentials, session cookies, media URLs or request context. Safe aggregates and hashes only. This local scratch path is not a portable archive.

readEpoch.mutations: Read-only role; native controlled and browser setup changes occur only in later, explicitly separate copy epochs.

readComparisons.method: One warm-up and five serial calls per owner on the same restored epoch, caches warm; complete DTO hashes match; selected scenarios only. CPU is app-process CPU, not database CPU. RSS samples are not whole-app peak memory. Top-level pg_stat_statements is inclusive; nested calls are separate and must not be added again. Shared reads may be served by OS cache; temp blocks are 8KiB; no production p95 or physical-disk claim.

nativeControlledAcceptance.boundary: Controlled existing admin/catalogue state on marked disposable actual-data copy; no fabricated identities or provider responses

wholeNativeResume.boundary: Real retained admin/account/catalogue; controlled finalization resume on marked copy. Only GETs to its actual Jellyfin origin are permitted, at most eight; no fabricated upstream replies or remote mutations.

final.boundary: Independent new browser context and page inside a single CLI invocation, avoiding automatic CLI aria snapshots for the probe page; actual Library/admin and retained artwork, external transport blocked

beforeDisposalFix.boundary: Independent new browser context and page inside a single CLI invocation, avoiding automatic CLI aria snapshots for the probe page; actual Library/admin and retained artwork, external transport blocked

browserRetention.retainer: Independent-context heap root: Document -> MediaQueryMatcher -> native StrongMember ViewportChangeListener -> detached img -> detached media card. Empty image candidate implicated; valid inline disposal source leaves one detached card.
rejectedExperiments: Removing src alone did not release native listener retention.
Native eager loading/sizes-only experiment did not fix it; MediaCard changes reverted.
browserRetention.limits: External transport blocked, mostly failed artwork. Short forced-GC headless metadata run; no decoded/GPU/physical-device or long-soak plateau claim.

realMediaCrop.boundary: Two actual accessible short videos; unchanged native FFmpeg arguments; original serial and current parallel controller calls; authenticated request context linked directly without hosted Jellyfin middleware; 25ms sampled child RSS excludes parent and can miss peaks; not a latency speedup comparison

taskCandidate.candidate: Terminal hash/group representative aggregate with max timestamp then UUID-text tie breaking; no index change.
taskCandidate.method: Two matched alternating original/candidate blocks, five measured calls per block, equal complete output hashes and uncontaminated top-level statement counts. Earlier mismatched epochs are excluded. No claims/write/WAL benefit asserted.
taskCandidate.remaining: A future replacement must win whole coordinated read/write/index/claim/cleanup measurements before adoption.

shippingRuntimeFocused.boundary: Pinned 6bb5dc195 runtime; same isolated source and actual-data acceptance epoch. Unit fixtures remain supplementary.
